title: Orphan Games: NES console in the FPGA
summary: A Nintendo Entertainment System rebuilt in the FPGA (fpganes by Ludvig Strigeus, GPL-2): CPU, picture chip, sound and cartridge mappers 0-4 in hardware. Play free homebrew games from the browser (keyboard or a USB gamepad) or on an ORPHAN Remote (CYD) screen. Carts up to 64 KB program + 32 KB graphics. by JMSCNC, makers of RotatoCAM.

slots.1: NES console (cart, frame buffer, sound, pads)
